summary: @Prof_Bruckner Begin next semester by annotating mentor text with students. I know I am going to add more. My biggest struggle in my writing classes was often getting across the point a short writing response is different than a short answer test question.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @Prof_Bruckner Begin next semester by annotating mentor text with students. I know I am going to add more. My biggest struggle in my writing classes was often getting across the point a short writing response is different than a short answer test question.
